settings.heading: Gluten free travel with calm, useful guidance
settings.subheading: Coeliac Traveller is a soft, editorial-style area inside MrChocolate for destination inspiration, gluten free travel recommendations, trusted products, and future creator-led content.

settings.heading: A branded content space built to grow later
settings.body:
This page creates the first dedicated Coeliac Traveller experience inside the existing MrChocolate Shopify theme without redesigning the rest of the store.

It gives you a clean base for travel guides, blog posts, social-first content, email growth, and product recommendations while staying completely additive.
settings.highlight_text: These sections are modular so you can reuse them later on other templates, launch a larger content hub, or transition Coeliac Traveller to its own domain more easily.

settings.title: Gluten Free Guides
settings.text: Create destination guides, airport food tips, and practical planning advice for travelling coeliac families.

settings.text: Build content around packing, research, safe dining questions, and how to navigate travel day with confidence.
